finalists.label: Cholesteatoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including a hypodense lesion in the middle ear, a hyperintense 23-mm lesion at the edge of the petrous bone, and a 2-centimeter mass found during drilling of the hypoplastic petrous bone.

finalists.label: Fistula
finalists.why: It is supported by findings of a fistula originating from the middle ear and a millimetric fistula at the tip of the mastoid running into the sternocleidomastoid muscle.
